text: Was at a nearby hotel and walked to nearby store to pick up bottled water and sundries.  Always make it a point to go to McD's on vacation because they still make apple pies by deep frying compared to US where apple pies are now baked.  This particular location seems like a smaller McD's because I believe there was an abbreviated menu. This place was filthy!  At least the downstairs lobby was...(there is a larger seating area on the second floor which was moderately clean).  What was a total turn off was walking in there; getting apple pies; then looking for a place to sit down only to see a bunch of trays of food with uneaten burgers and fries on them.  Despite the filth I went back here out of sheer cost and convenience.  Stopped back here at breakfast one time on the way to an excursion - still dirty.  Then another night because we couldn't find ice cream at the nearby store so I took the kids to get McFlurries.  Of course I ordered an apple pie too.  After paying for the order and waiting for the apple pies to be cooked they informed me the ice cream machine was broken.  I think this place knows they have a captive audience via the weekly flow of new tourists.  They staff the place with minimally qualified people who keep the lights on and do the bare minimum...
author: Steve

text: Horrible presentation of burgers. Fries were thrown on the tray and spread all over the tray.  Premium signature burger came wrapped in papper like a small cheeseburger would be presented.  Here's the worst part, they had no soda and said the machine was broken and they couldn't take credit cards.  So after waiting ten minutes in line and ordering our food when we saw the presentation we asked for a refund.  Very strange McDonald's experience for anywhere in the world especially somewhere like Cancun which is a mega tourist destination and has multiple McDonald's locations.  It's not like this McDonald's is in the middle of nowhere in Chiapas or some rural location. There is obviously some type of issues with management or even the owners of this location because they didn't even take credit cards.
author: Rob

text: The worst McDonald's in the Whole Wide World, restrooms are extremely dirty, and broken and they smell awful, stairs are about to  fall off, the roof has leakings when it rains, yesterday I went there by car, the guy on the drive thru took my order, he repeated the order and when I got the next window they told me they did not understood that I ordered,  and it took them 28 minutes to make 2 hamburgers, french fries who by the way they were cold, they forgot to add ketchup, straws and napkins. When I went down and told them they forgot everything they just did not know what to do.  ( And the prize for the worst McDonald's in the world goes for this one).
author: José Diaz-Ordaz Castillo

text: Arrived, placed order and took 17 minutes to get food. While we are waiting for our food, we notice all of the staff taking selfies at different places. Notice that no one is using gloves after handling their phone, etc. I thought maybe there is a reason for our food to be late? We waited more until one of us decided to say so, all these great photos but what about our food? They acted like nothing happened and grabbed a few food items and waited more time. So, after the 17 minutes after a second question? We ate the food… well, we ate at 6pm ish and by 10ish we all had food poisoning. Just avoid this place at all costs.
author: Erick “Erick”

text: This is one of the worst McDonald's I've visited. They take a long time to get your order and then to get your food out. I try to get breakfast from here and even though it says they open at 8am, they don't give access until 830am. This morning I tried going for a burrito and they told me that the only things they had available were the sincronizadas and cuernitos because their equipment wasn't ready to prepare the rest of the menu,  this was at 845am. I really wish management would do something about this,  it's unbelievable that at opening your location isn't ready to serve the food on your menu.
author: Luis Arcos

text: 6 employees, two masks, zero gloves, slow as hell, and nasty!!  The man put the forks in the container holding the part people eat with.  The guy in the back was cleaning, once our order was placed he immediately started the order.  After 10 minutes we're still standing there disgusted and the 2 McMuffin still were not done!! This is not your normal Mcdonalds there was no aroma of food cooking or cooked, it was dead, they are slow, no respect,  no hand washing, I wasn't going to eat that mess, we just walked OUT,  I  didn't want anything they touched,  not even a refund!!!   It was just that BAD!!!
author: Mrs. Teresa Williams

text: If I could give this place zero stars I would! STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE. I watched the “cooks” handle my Food with bare hands and not just my food but everyone’s order because they forgot to turn on the fryer to make hash browns. So not only do I watch them touch my food but I’m watching my sandwich getting cold  while waiting for the oil to heat up. Worse was the manager who got defensive about his COVID protocols and when I asked for my money he gave it to me in change when I gave a 200 note! Stay away please!

text:
What kind of Resturant ( that too international franchise) does not accept credit card in this day and time. First of all, they said no fries until noon. Employees were all standing free but won’t start making fries. I decided to order something else and then they won’t take credit card.
McDonald should close this location since it’s the worst McDonald I have been to. I have been to multiple locations all over the world. I have never seen anyone not taking credit card.

text: One star is actually way too much!!! The worst Mc Donalds experience of my life. The location is very outdated and dirty. The lady at the register told me that the card payment did not work so I paid again with cash. When I got home, the amount was charged to my card after all. And the crowning glory of the story is that the staff worked in the kitchen without gloves and I was on the toilet all night with diarrhea. Never again!!! I want my money back!!!

text: The MD workers were standing around talking, the establishment was dirty. The male  cashier was trying to take orders and fix food! The ordering process went great getting the correct food was the problem it took them 3 times to get the order right and we were still missing food. We were given food with no napkins nor lids or straws for our drinks. They definitely need better supervision and structure I would recommend this location to anyone!

text:

Premises seemed filthy also. Also went upstairs to eat the breakfast and previous nights trays and rubbish was still on the tables.

Surely being a franchise these places must get spot checked?!
